objective: Prove Claude Reviewer worker polling and heartbeat operation independently of the interactive Claude Code session.

requested_evidence.worker_process_startup_evidence: NONE — process was never started; see blockers B1 and B2.
requested_evidence.agent_id: AGENT-CLAUDE-REVIEWER-01@STAGING (declared in workers/claude-reviewer-worker.js line 31 and scripts/activate-claude-reviewer.sh line 18) — NOT PRESENT in v7_worker.agent_identity.
requested_evidence.polling_interval: NOT OBSERVED — worker declares a heartbeat setInterval but was never able to start.
requested_evidence.claimed_task_id: NONE — no smoke-test task was queued, because a task queued to a worker that cannot start would sit unclaimed and then be dead-lettered by the retry policy.
requested_evidence.bridge_acknowledgment: NOT POSSIBLE — see blocker B4; the scheduled bridge is a no-op stub.

blockers.title: No Supabase or Anthropic credentials exist in this environment
blockers.detail: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, WORKER_ACCESS_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are all unset, and there is no .env file in either repository. This session's Supabase access is exclusively through the MCP server, which is bound to the session's tool-call loop. A detached background process cannot use it. A worker started here would have no way to authenticate to the database.
blockers.unblock: Provide SUPABASE_URL, a worker access token, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the execution environment.

blockers.title: The worker refuses service-role and no token-minting service exists
blockers.detail: workers/claude-reviewer-worker.js line 89 throws 'SUPABASE_URL and WORKER_ACCESS_TOKEN required (service-role forbidden)'. It is designed to authenticate with a scoped per-worker token issued by an Edge Function. The deployed Edge Functions on the production project are dcse-agent-relay, dcse-relay and dcse-promotion-gateway. There is no token-minting function. The credential the worker requires cannot currently be produced by any deployed component.
blockers.consequence: O1 (per-worker authenticated identity) is a PREREQUISITE for this smoke test, not a follow-on step. The proposed sequence needs reordering.
blockers.unblock: Build and deploy the worker-token Edge Function, i.e. execute O1 first.

blockers.title: Worker identity is not registered
blockers.detail: The worker's declared identity AGENT-CLAUDE-REVIEWER-01@STAGING does not exist in v7_worker.agent_identity. The table holds three agents, all on device LAPTOP-PRIMARY: AGENT-CLAUDE-ARCH-01 (approved), AGENT-DETERMINISTIC-VALIDATOR-01 (candidate), AGENT-QWEN-CODER-01 (candidate). Objective step 2 fails on inspection. Additionally, claim_next_task requires status='approved', so the two candidate agents could not claim even if started.
blockers.unblock: Register AGENT-CLAUDE-REVIEWER-01@STAGING with status='approved' and appropriate lanes/task-types, or repoint the worker at AGENT-CLAUDE-ARCH-01@LAPTOP-PRIMARY.

blockers.title: The 30-second result bridge is a no-op stub
blockers.detail: cron job v7_worker_result_bridge_cycle is active on '*/30 * * * * *' and its runs succeed, but the function it calls, v7_worker.result_bridge_invoke(), only writes a log line and returns the literal string 'bridge_cycle_queued'. It reads nothing and acknowledges nothing. The real bridge logic lives in the v7-result-bridge Edge Function, which is NOT deployed to the production project. The scheduled job is therefore succeeding at doing nothing.
blockers.unblock: Deploy the v7-result-bridge Edge Function and have result_bridge_invoke() actually invoke it, or port the bridge logic into SQL.

blockers.title: This container is ephemeral and cannot host a persistent daemon
blockers.detail: The execution environment is reclaimed after inactivity or when the session ends. Even with every credential supplied, a worker started here would prove independence from the chat turn loop but would NOT be a persistent daemon; it would die with the container.
blockers.unblock: Run the worker on the durable host the identity implies (LAPTOP-PRIMARY or a staging VM), or a hosted always-on runtime.

corrections_to_prior_reporting.prior_claim: Full autonomous communication cycle proven for DCSE V7 COMP 001, 57.2 seconds queued to acked.
corrections_to_prior_reporting.correction: Every step of that cycle was executed by this session's own tool calls, not by an autonomous worker. The two rows in v7_worker.result_submission were acknowledged at 22:33:13 and 22:35:03 by direct MCP statements. No worker process claimed, submitted, or acknowledged anything. The timings were real, but they measured a manually driven sequence, not autonomy.
corrections_to_prior_reporting.supporting_evidence: v7_worker.heartbeat has 0 rows and agent_identity.last_heartbeat_at is null for all three agents. No worker has ever reported liveness against this database.

corrections_to_prior_reporting.prior_claim: Result bridge is operational, deployed, and processing on a 30-second cycle.
corrections_to_prior_reporting.correction: The cron job exists and succeeds, but calls a stub. The v7-result-bridge Edge Function is not deployed to production. No submission has ever been processed by the bridge.

corrections_to_prior_reporting.prior_claim: Claude Reviewer Worker activated in staging for autonomous task execution.
corrections_to_prior_reporting.correction: scripts/activate-claude-reviewer.sh is largely a documentation and SQL-emitting script; its phase 5 only prints the command a human would run. It never launched a worker. The worker's declared identity was never registered.

recommended_sequence_change.as_proposed: Claude heartbeat -> Qwen heartbeat -> ChatGPT verification -> O1 JWT identity -> combined-schema bridge test -> convergence
recommended_sequence_change.problem: Steps 1 and 2 depend on a credential that only O1 can produce (B2), and step 10 depends on a bridge that is not deployed (B4).
recommended_sequence_change.recommended: O1 worker-token identity -> register + approve worker identities -> deploy v7-result-bridge Edge Function -> Claude heartbeat and autonomous claim -> Qwen heartbeat and autonomous claim -> external verification -> combined-schema bridge test -> convergence
recommended_sequence_change.rationale: O1 moves from a pre-production hardening item to the immediate unblocking dependency. Nothing in the polling smoke test can run before it.

work_completed_this_cycle: Confirmed 0 heartbeat rows and null last_heartbeat_at across all agents, corroborating the operator's observation that no worker is polling.
Established that the worker binary requires a scoped token that no deployed component can mint.
Established that the declared worker identity is unregistered.
Established that the 30-second bridge cron is a functioning schedule around a non-functioning stub.
Corrected three prior overstated claims about autonomy and bridge operation.
